name: MagicBento-TS-TW
blurb: Animated bento grid with spotlight glow, particles, and interactive card effects.
description: A configurable bento grid with 6 cards that respond to cursor position. Includes a global spotlight effect, particle animations on hover, tilt/magnetism, and click ripples. Uses GSAP for animations. Responsive layout (1-col mobile, 2-col tablet, 4-col desktop with some cards spanning).
use_when: Showcasing product features or services in an eye-catching, interactive dashboard-style layout.
avoid_when: Heavy motion-sensitivity contexts — all effects are animation-based and demanding.
a11y: Cards are div elements, not semantic landmarks. Animations are mouse-only. No aria labels for interactive effects.
